schema.text: What kind of connection is needed here?
schema.help: A connection lets you get past a barrier, such as a road, a railway or a difference in level.

options.text: A crossing on the road (zebra crossing, traffic light, traffic island)
A ramp or a lift, without steps
There is one already, but it is closed or cannot be used

en.#What kind of connection is needed here?: What kind of connection is needed here?
en.#A connection lets you get past a barrie: A connection lets you get past a barrier, such as a road, a railway or a difference in level.
en.#A crossing on the road (zebra crossing,: A crossing on the road (zebra crossing, traffic light, traffic island)
en.#A ramp or a lift, without steps: A ramp or a lift, without steps

it.#What kind of connection is needed here?: Che tipo di collegamento servirebbe qui?
it.#A connection lets you get past a barrie: Un collegamento ti permette di superare una barriera, come una strada, una ferrovia o un dislivello.
it.#A crossing on the road (zebra crossing,: Un attraversamento sulla strada (strisce pedonali, semaforo, isola salvagente)
it.#A ramp or a lift, without steps: Una rampa o un ascensore, senza gradini
it.#Stairs or an escalator: Una scala o una scala mobile
it.#There is one already, but it is closed: Esiste già, ma è chiuso o non si può usare

fr.#What kind of connection is needed here?: Quel type de liaison faudrait-il ici ?
fr.#A connection lets you get past a barrie: Un passage permet de franchir un obstacle, comme une route, une voie ferrée ou une différence de niveau.
fr.#A crossing on the road (zebra crossing,: Une traversée sur la chaussée (passage piéton, feu, refuge)
fr.#A ramp or a lift, without steps: Une rampe ou un ascenseur, sans marches
fr.#There is one already, but it is closed: Il en existe déjà un, mais il est fermé ou inutilisable

de.#What kind of connection is needed here?: Welche Art von Verbindung wird hier gebraucht?
de.#A connection lets you get past a barrie: Eine Verbindung ermöglicht es, ein Hindernis zu überwinden, etwa eine Straße, eine Bahnlinie oder einen Höhenunterschied.
de.#A crossing on the road (zebra crossing,: Ein Übergang auf der Fahrbahn (Zebrastreifen, Ampel, Verkehrsinsel)
de.#A ramp or a lift, without steps: Eine Rampe oder ein Aufzug, ohne Stufen
de.#There is one already, but it is closed: Es gibt bereits einen, aber er ist gesperrt oder nicht benutzbar

tr.#What kind of connection is needed here?: Burada ne tür bir bağlantıya ihtiyaç var?
tr.#A connection lets you get past a barrie: Bağlantı, bir yol, demiryolu veya kot farkı gibi bir engeli aşmanızı sağlar.
tr.#A crossing on the road (zebra crossing,: Yol üzerinde bir geçit (yaya geçidi, trafik ışığı, refüj)
tr.#A bridge or footbridge: Bir köprü veya yaya üst geçidi
tr.#There is one already, but it is closed: Zaten var, ancak kapalı veya kullanılamıyor

fa.#What kind of connection is needed here?: اینجا چه نوع ارتباطی لازم است؟
fa.#A connection lets you get past a barrie: یک اتصال به شما امکان می‌دهد از یک مانع بگذرید، مانند خیابان، خط راه‌آهن یا اختلاف ارتفاع.
fa.#A crossing on the road (zebra crossing,: گذرگاهی روی خیابان (خط عابر پیاده، چراغ راهنمایی، جزیره‌ی ایمنی)
fa.#There is one already, but it is closed: از قبل وجود دارد، اما بسته است یا قابل استفاده نیست

hu.#A connection lets you get past a barrie: Az átkelés lehetővé teszi, hogy túljusson egy akadályon, például egy úton, egy vasútvonalon vagy egy szintkülönbségen.
hu.#There is one already, but it is closed: Már van, de le van zárva vagy nem használható

ar.#A connection lets you get past a barrie: يتيح لك الممر تجاوز عائق، مثل طريق أو سكة حديد أو فرق في المستوى.
ar.#A crossing on the road (zebra crossing,: معبر على الطريق (ممر مشاة مخطط، إشارة ضوئية، جزيرة أمان)
ar.#There is one already, but it is closed: يوجد واحد بالفعل، لكنه مغلق أو غير صالح للاستخدام
